text: 据新华社，商务部回应法德要求欧盟强化保护主义工具。 Francis Halzen独揽2026年诺贝尔物理学奖：主导南极“冰立方”项目，开启中微子天文学新纪元。 据新华社，沙土巴三国决定落实共同防御在沙特部署军力。 德国8月工厂订单大幅下滑，制造业复苏遭遇挫折。 法国极右翼领导人勒庞抛出雄心勃勃的财政计划，目标2032年前将法国赤字率降至3%以下。 报道：DeepSeek融资规模超预期冲击800亿人民币，腾讯和宁德时代领投。 中国AI双雄冲刺港股：月之暗面完成融资最早明年Q1上市 ，可灵AI拟募资至少10亿美元。 Altman深度访谈：人类灭绝风险非零、开
text_en: According to Xinhua, the Ministry of Commerce responded to France and Germany's call for the EU to strengthen protectionist tools. Francis Halzen wins the 2026 Nobel Prize in Physics alone: leading the Antarctic "IceCube" project, opening a new era of neutrino astronomy. According to Xinhua, Saudi Arabia, Egypt and Turkey decided to implement joint defense and deploy military forces in Saudi Arabia. German factory orders fell sharply in August, dealing a setback to the manufacturing recovery. French far-right leader Le Pen unveils an ambitious fiscal plan, aiming to cut France's deficit ratio below 3% by 2032. Report: DeepSeek's funding round exceeds expectations, surpassing RMB 80 billion, with Tencent and CATL leading the investment. China's two AI champions sprint toward Hong Kong listings: Moonshot AI completes funding and could list as early as Q1 next year, while Kling AI plans to raise at least $1 billion. Altman in-depth interview: human extinction risk is non-zero, open
